name: Hardware Ray Tracing Voxel Occlusion
definition: A method to determine if a ray from `origin` to `dir` is occluded by any solid voxel within `max_dist`, using hardware ray tracing (BLAS/TLAS) combined with a software DDA for precise voxel-level intersection testing.
summary: Hardware Ray Tracing Voxel Occlusion uses GPU RT cores for coarse BVH traversal to find candidate bricks, then applies a shared software Amanatides-Woo DDA for precise voxel resolution.
